answer_2.quote: Our model's accuracy is 81.2% on simple, 2x2 problems... On larger problems, it achieves 77.8% perfect mappings (guess level=13.1%).

answer_4.quote: We recruited 304 participants using social media... In the closed-world phase, the participants received ten structure mapping problems, in which they were asked to match instances from B to T. In the open-world phase, participants were instructed to fill in the blank with an entity that preserves the analogy.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked to map each source entity to a target entity (closed-world) or to suggest a missing entity that preserves the analogy (open-world).
